new_activity.author: greptile-apps
new_activity.body: ultra skips model limits When agent.reasoning_effort is ultra, this early return skips every model-specific limit. For example, o3-mini on OpenAI supports at most high, but this path sends ultra when the receiver advertises it, or xhigh otherwise. Both exceed that model's limit and can make the chat fail. Preserve ultra for models that support it, but apply the selected model's limits before checking what the receiver can parse.
